rationale: Use dt/tau <= 0.05 for the configured 300 Hz low-pass cutoff (tau=1/(2*pi*f)); at 25 us, dt/tau is approximately 0.0471. This is a numerical stability choice. It is not calibrated or tuned using real event data.
